content: Hi there! This is Alex from the school office. How can I help you with your account or payments today?

Thanks for letting me know! I see a payment of $175 received via Zelle at 10:38 AM today, credited to your account under reference number ZEL-6182041. That matches Emily Carter's profile, student ID EC2025.
Perfect. The transfer should have come from my Chase account ending in 4492. Just want to double-check everything is in order before the registration closes.

You're all set, registration deadline is tomorrow at noon, so you made it just in time! The Chase account ending 4492 and the confirmation email to emily.carter.family@outlook.com both match our records.
Great. Will Emily get a receipt or confirmation email soon?
Absolutely. The receipt for payment reference ZEL-6182041 will be emailed to emily.carter.family@outlook.com within the next hour. If you need a physical copy for your records, just let me know.
No, email is perfect. Thanks for confirming so quickly.
No problem at all! If you have any urgent questions before tomorrow's cut-off, you can reach out at (555) 267-8801, all your documentation is squared away for Emily Carter, student ID EC2025.
